answer: Each seat's rewards settle into a joint vault that only two seats drawn at random from the whole register can open together, so every payout needs an unrelated cosigner. The registry traces funding trails and referral chains that spread like a vine; when the two cosigners prove to share an owner, both vaults burn down to an ember and the stake behind each is forfeited. A farm of k clones draws itself as a pair roughly k squared times a season, and each self-pairing destroys both stakes. An honest seat, never secretly coupled, keeps its anchor in the register and collects.
